translations.text: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard and have seen with our eyes, which we have seen, and our hands ministered to the word of life.
And that life was revealed, and what we have seen we testify to and declare to you: that eternal life which was with the Father and was made manifest to us;
what we have seen we testify to and declare to you, so that you too may have fellowship with us; and our fellowship is with the Father and with his Son Jesus Christ.
And I write this to you so that my joy may be full.
And this is the promise which we heard from him and declare to you: that God is light, and there is no darkness in him at all.
If we say that we have fellowship with him while we walk in darkness, we lie and do not do the truth.
If we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus his Son cleanses us from all sin.
If we say that we have committed no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just, so that he forgives us our sins and cleanses us from all falsehood.
If we say that we have not sinned at all, we lie to him, and his word is not in us.
My children, I write this to you so that you may not sin. And if anyone does sin, we have a comforter with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous.
And he is the one who forgives our sins, and not only our sins, but those of the whole world.
And by this let us know that we know him: if we keep his commandments.
Whoever says, "I have known him," and does not keep his commandments is a liar, and the truth is not in him.
But whoever keeps his words, in him the love of God has truly been made perfect. By this you know that we are in him.
Whoever says that he abides in him ought himself to walk just as he walked.
Beloved, I am not writing a new commandment to you, but the first commandment, which you have had from the beginning. That first commandment is the word that you have heard.
And again I am writing a new commandment to you, which is true before him and among you, for the darkness is passing away and the true light is already appearing.
Whoever says that he is in the light and hates his brother is still in darkness even now.
Whoever loves his brother is in the light, and there is no stumbling in him.
But whoever hates his brother is in darkness and walks in darkness, and does not know where he is going, for the darkness has blinded his eyes.
I write to you, children, because your sins are forgiven you through his name.
I write to you, fathers, because you have known the one who was first.
I write to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God abides in you, and you have overcome the evil one.
Do not love this world, nor anything that belongs to the world. If anyone loves this world, the love of God is not in him.
For everything in the world is this: the desire of the flesh, the desire of the eyes, and the arrogance of this life. This is not from the Father; it is from the world.
And this world will pass away, and all its desire with it. But whoever does the will of God will remain forever.
Children, it is the last hour. As you have heard that the Antichrist is coming, even now there are many antichrists. By this we know that it is the last hour.
They went out from us, but they were not of us. If they had been of us, they would have remained with us. But they went out so that it might be made plain that not all of them are of us.
And you have knowledge from the Holy One, and you know everything.
I did not write to you in this way because you know [?] the truth. Rather, you know it, and you know that no lie is from the truth.
Who is the liar? Is it not the one who denies that Jesus is not the Christ? This is the antichrist. Whoever denies the Father denies the Son as well.
Everyone who denies the Son does not have the Father with him either. Whoever confesses the Son, the Father is not [?] with him either.
Let what you heard from the beginning remain with you. If what you heard from the beginning remains with you, you too will remain with the Father and with the Son.
And this is the promise that he promised us: eternal life.
I have written this to you about those who are deceiving you.

And as for you, the life that you received from him abides with you, and you have no need for anyone to teach you. That same life will teach you about everything. It is true and is not a lie, and as it has taught you, abide in him.
Now, children, abide in him, so that when he appears I may have boldness and not be put to shame before him at his coming.
If you see that he is righteous, know that everyone who does righteousness is born of him.
See how much love the Father has given us, that we should be called children of God, and so we are. This is why the world does not know us: because it did not know him either.
Beloved, we are now children of God, and what we will be has not yet been revealed. This we know: when he appears, we will be like him, because we will see him as he is.
And everyone who has this hope in him purifies himself, just as he is pure.
Everyone who commits sin also commits lawlessness, and sin is lawlessness.
And you know that he appeared to blot out our sins, and there is no sin in him.
No one who abides in him sins. No one who goes on sinning has seen him or knows him.
Children, let no one deceive you. Whoever does righteousness is righteous.
Whoever commits sin is of the devil, because the devil has been sinning from the beginning. This is why the Son of God appeared: to destroy the works of the devil.
No one who is born of God commits sin, because his seed abides in him, and he cannot sin, because he is born of God.
By this the children of God and the children of the devil are made plain: no one who does not do righteousness is of God, and neither is anyone who does not love his brother.
For this is the commandment that you heard from the beginning: that we should love one another.
Was not Cain of the evil one, and did he not kill his brother? And why did he kill him? Because his deeds were evil, but his brother's were righteous.
Do not be surprised, brothers, that the world hates you.
We know that we have passed from death to life, because we love the brothers. Whoever does not love remains in death.
Everyone who hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life remaining in him.
By this let us know love: that he laid down his life for us; and it befits us also, for the brothers, the glory [?] of ourselves.
If anyone has the livelihood of this world and sees his brother in need of something, and closes his heart against him, how does the love of God abide in him?
Children, let us not love in word, nor with the tongue only, but in deed and in truth.
By this let us be known that we are of the truth, and before him our hearts give us assurance.
If our heart condemns us, God is greater than our heart and knows all things.
Beloved, if our heart does not condemn us, we have boldness toward God.
And whatever we ask, we receive from him, because we keep his commandments and do what is pleasing before him.
And this is his commandment: that we believe in the name of his Son Jesus Christ, and love one another, just as he gave us the commandment.
And whoever keeps his commandments abides in him, and he himself in him; and by this we know that he is in us, by the Spirit which he gave us.
Beloved, do not believe every spirit, but test the spirits, whether they are from God, for many false prophets have gone out into the world.
By this the Spirit of God is known: every spirit that confesses Jesus Christ come in the flesh is from God;

and every spirit that does not confess Jesus come in the flesh is not from God. And this is the one concerning the Antichrist, of which you have heard that he is to come, and now he is already in the world.
But you are from God, children, and you have overcome them; for he who is in you is greater than he who is in the world.
They are of the world; therefore they speak of the world, and the world listens to them.
But we are from God; whoever knows God listens to us; whoever is not from God does not listen to us. By this, then, let us know the spirit of truth and the spirit of deceit.
My beloved, let us love one another, for love is from God, and everyone who loves is born of God and knows God.
Whoever does not love does not know God, for God is love.
By this the love of God was revealed among us: that God sent his only-begotten Son into the world, so that we might live through him.
By this love is seen: not that we loved God, but that he first loved us and sent his Son as the propitiation for our sins.
Beloved, if God so loved us, we also ought to have love for one another.
No one has ever seen God. If we love one another, God is among us, and his love is made perfect among us.
By this you know that we abide in him and he in us: he has given us of his Spirit.
And we have seen and we testify that the Father sent the Son as Savior of the world.
Whoever confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God is with him, and he is with God.
And we have come to know and we believe the love that God has toward us. God is love, and whoever remains in love abides with God, and God with him.
By this love is made perfect with us, so that we may have boldness on the day of judgment, because as he himself is, so also are we in the world.
There is no fear in love; rather, perfect love drives out fear, for fear involves torment, and the one who fears is not perfect in love.
Let us love, for God first loved us.
If anyone says, "I love God," and hates his brother, he is a liar; whoever does not love his brother whom he has seen cannot love God whom he has not seen.
And we have received this commandment from him: that whoever loves God should love his brother also.
Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ is born of God, and everyone who loves the parent loves also the one born of him.
By this you know that we love the children of God: when we love God and do his commandments.
For this is the love of God: that we keep his commandments; and his commandments are not heavy.
For everyone who is born of God overcomes the world, and this is the victory that overcomes the world: our faith.
[?] . . . that Jesus is the Son of God.
For this is the one who came by water and blood; and the Spirit is the witness, for the Spirit is truth.
For there are three who testify: the Spirit, the blood, and the water, and these three are directed toward one.
If we have received the testimony of men, the testimony of God is greater; for this is the testimony of God, that he has testified concerning his Son.

Whoever believes in the Son of God has the testimony of God within himself; whoever does not believe the Son has shown him to be a liar, because he did not believe the testimony that God testified concerning his Son.
And this is the testimony: that God has given us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.
Whoever has the Son has life also; whoever does not have the Son of God does not have life.
I have written this to you so that you may know that you have eternal life, you who believe in the name of his Son.
And this is the boldness that we have toward him: that whatever we ask according to his will, he will hear us.
And if we know that he will hear us in whatever we ask, we know that we have the request that we have asked of him.

If anyone sees his brother committing a sin that is not unto death, let him ask, and He will give him life, to those who sin not unto death. There is a sin unto death; I do not say that he should ask concerning that.
Every falsehood is sin, and there is a sin unto death.
We know that everyone who has been born of God keeps himself, and the evil one does not touch him.
We know that we are of God, and the whole world stands upon the evil one.
And we know that the Son of God is coming and has given us understanding, so that we may know the true God; and we are with his true Son. This is the true God and eternal life.
Children, guard yourselves from idols.
